text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Bearing the burden of countless<n>hopes, Mejiro
Ryan grows stronger<n>each day as she prepares for
the<n>Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubting the sheer<n>amount of effort
she's put into<n>ensuring her own victory. Mejiro
Bright, too, has no doubt that Mejiro<n>Ryan will win
the upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Ines Fujin intends to live up to<n>the hopes of all
those who see their<n>dreams in her. No matter how
formidable her foe, she can't afford<n>to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Burning with the desire to live up to<n>her fans'
expectations and dream<n>alongside them, Ines steps
onto the<n>track. The Takarazuka Kinen is about<n>to
begin!
